_about: Bluetooth drivers built by bluetooth/build.py. version and note go into the kext; source_date_epoch fixes Lilu's build date so a rebuild is byte-identical; installed_sha256 is the binary in the EFI now (build.py reports whether the build matches it). Change version, note and source_date_epoch together for a new release.
